name: studio-water-ford-lake
description: test.md 'set_water ford and lake against the WE': a Lordaeron Summer map made in Studio (new_map 64x64), a ford along a line (set_water ford, the ground sloped down under the surface with no cliff, 38 deep in the middle) and a lake (set_water lake, an ellipse, 102 deep in the middle). The World Editor opens Studio's pack and saves it with no edit; Studio packs it again unchanged: the editor keeps the terrain corner for corner (water flags, water and ground heights, layers) and its pathing map of the sloped water (the wading and ship bits) is Studio's (branch we-batch-6)
